rust_summary: A gated name-tag anchor hook in camera-relative world blocks.
doc_summary: Set native_render_name_tag_position_listened to true to receive native_render_name_tag_position(entity_id, kind, anchor). The mutable DVec3 anchor uses camera-relative world blocks and the same axes as BlockEntityDraw::pose_matrix. It moves the name and below-name score together without changing visibility, distance or sneaking rules. It is not called by shown-name diagnostics. Require hooks @API:render_name_tag_position@ or higher.
